_comment: A ratchet, not a target. The gate fails when coverage drops BELOW these
numbers; it never fails for being above them, and it does not raise itself.
Raising is deliberate: a floor that follows the last run turns one lucky
commit into a permanent obligation and teaches people to switch the gate off.
Set 2026-09-05 at the measured values, rounded down to the nearest whole
point. The August figure was 75.4% statements with prompt_loop.ts at 50.1%;
the jump is partly real tests and partly the removal of agent.ts, 339 lines
